title: September gardening tips for St. Louisans
overview:
**Project Overview**

            From cleaning your beds to planting a tree, September offers plenty of work for home gardeners to do. This feature provides seasonal gardening advice for St. Louisans.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the seasonal gardening topic, interviewed Ian Graves of Quiet Village Landscaping, developed the story, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.
